title: Root Canal Treatment in Malviya Nagar
body:
[gd_img name="dr-shikha-reception" alt="Dr Shikha Goel, endodontist, at the Goel Dental reception" cap="Dr Shikha Goel, endodontist"]

Signs you may need one

  • Pain that wakes you, or lingering pain after hot or cold
  • Swelling or pus near the tooth or gum
  • A deep cavity, crack or injury reaching the nerve
  • A darkened or loose tooth
  • An earlier root canal that has failed

Only an exam and X-ray confirm it. Some teeth need just a filling; a few cannot be saved.

What happens, step by step

  1. Exam and digital X-ray (RVG) to confirm the diagnosis.
  2. Local anaesthetic so the area is numb.
  3. Cleaning the canals with rotary files; length measured with an apex locator; rubber dam to keep saliva out.
  4. Sealing with gutta-percha, using warm obturation (System B).
  5. A crown on most back teeth so the tooth does not break when chewing.

One visit or several?

Most root canals take one to three visits. Some teeth can be finished in one sitting: see single-sitting root canal. Molars, re-treatments and cracked teeth may need the dental microscope.

The clinic makes zirconia and ceramic crowns on site (CAD/CAM), so the crown can sometimes be fitted the same day.

Root canal or extraction?

If a tooth can be saved, a root canal with a crown keeps your natural tooth and bite. An extracted tooth usually needs an implant or bridge; otherwise nearby teeth can drift.

After treatment

Mild soreness for a few days is common, more often after a repeat root canal. Ordinary pain relief usually helps and it settles within about a week. Call if you have swelling, fever or pain that is getting worse.

Questions

Does a root canal hurt?

The tooth is numbed first. Most patients feel pressure rather than pain. Laughing-gas sedation is available for anxious patients.

How long does a root canal treated tooth last?

With a crown, brushing, flossing and yearly check-ups, a root canal treated tooth can last many years.

Do you redo failed root canals?

Yes. Re-treatment, microscopic root canals, apicoectomy and removal of broken instruments are done at the clinic.

How much does a root canal cost in Delhi at Goel Dental?

From ₹4,500 for a front tooth to ₹6,500 for a molar, ₹7,500 single-sitting and ₹8,500 microscopic, plus a crown where needed.

quick: A root canal removes infected pulp from inside a tooth so the tooth can be kept. At Goel Dental it is done by an endodontist, usually in one to three visits of 15–30 minutes, and most back teeth then need a crown.

title: Single-Sitting Root Canal Treatment
body:
Who it suits

  • Teeth being prepared for a crown or veneer for cosmetic reasons
  • Sensitivity with little or no pain
  • No pus or swelling, and no infection visible on the X-ray
  • Teeth that have not had a root canal before

No equipment makes one-visit treatment right for every tooth. Dr Goel decides after the X-ray. If the tooth is not suitable, the standard root canal is done over two or three visits.

How it is done in one visit

Digital X-ray (RVG), CBCT for complex roots, rubber dam isolation, rotary NiTi files (X-Smart), an apex locator, a dental microscope when needed, and warm obturation to seal the canals.

Is it more painful?

No more than a multi-visit root canal. Any soreness afterwards is usually mild and settles with ordinary pain relief.

Crown the same day

With the on-site CAD/CAM system, a zirconia or ceramic crown can often be made and fitted the same day. See crowns and bridges.

Fee

Single-sitting root canal: ₹7,500. Crown extra.

Fees from the clinic's 2026 fee list; older pages on the site show different figures. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm fees[/gd_confirm] Your exact fee is given in writing after the exam.

Questions

How long does a single-sitting root canal take?

Usually 30–60 minutes from start to finish.

Can every tooth be done in one sitting?

No. Teeth with pus, swelling, severe pain or a failed earlier root canal usually need more than one visit.

title: Dental Emergency in Malviya Nagar
body:
Go to a hospital emergency department now if swelling spreads to the eye or neck, or you have fever, trouble breathing or trouble swallowing.

Call or WhatsApp first

Phone [gd_phone] or [gd_wa t="Emergency"] with a photo. Same-day emergency appointments: [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm same-day policy and after-hours number[/gd_confirm]

First aid while you travel

Severe toothache

Rinse with warm salt water, floss gently to remove trapped food, and take ordinary pain relief as directed on the pack. Do not put aspirin on the gum.

Broken or chipped tooth

Rinse with warm water, keep any piece in milk, hold a cold compress on the cheek and avoid chewing on that side.

Knocked-out adult tooth

Hold it by the crown, not the root. Rinse briefly in milk. Put it back in the socket if you can, or keep it in milk, and come in straight away. The first hour matters most.

Bleeding after an extraction

Bite firmly on folded gauze for 30 minutes without checking. Sit upright; avoid rinsing and hot drinks. Call if it does not settle.

Swollen gum or face

Hold a cold compress on the outside of the cheek and call the clinic. Do not apply heat.

What usually happens at the visit

An exam and X-ray, then relief of pain: often starting a root canal, an extraction, or bonding a chipped tooth. Consultation ₹500; X-ray ₹150 for 1–3 teeth. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm[/gd_confirm]

title: Dental Implants in Malviya Nagar
body:
[gd_img name="implant-model" alt="Dental implant model showing implant, abutment and crown" cap="Implant, abutment and crown"]

Who it is for

  • One missing tooth, without cutting down the teeth beside it
  • Several missing teeth: individual implants or an implant bridge
  • All teeth in a jaw: see All-on-4 and All-on-6
  • Loose dentures that need support

Bone, gum health and medical history decide suitability. Bone grafting or a sinus lift may be needed first.

How treatment runs

  1. Free consultation and CBCT scan to measure the bone and plan the position.
  2. Placement under local anaesthetic, guided by a digital plan and 3D-printed guide where suitable.
  3. Healing, usually a few months, while the implant bonds with the bone.
  4. Crown fitted on the implant.

If a missing tooth is not replaced

Neighbouring teeth can drift into the gap, the jaw bone there slowly shrinks, and chewing shifts to other teeth.

Implant, bridge or denture?

A bridge is faster but needs the teeth either side cut down. A denture costs least but is removable. An implant stands alone and preserves bone. The dentist explains which suits you after the scan.

Questions

Is the implant consultation free?

Yes, according to the clinic's 2026 fee list. A CBCT scan is charged if it is needed for planning.

Can diabetics get implants?

Often yes, if blood sugar is well controlled. The dentist reviews your medical history first.

How long does the whole process take?

Usually a few months from placement to the final crown, longer if bone grafting is needed.

Do you offer EMI?

Yes, on leading credit cards. Ask the front desk which cards and tenures apply.

title: Full-Mouth Dental Implants: All-on-4 and All-on-6
body:
All-on-4

Four implants placed at planned angles support a complete set of fixed teeth. Angling the back implants uses the bone that is available, which often avoids extensive grafting.

All-on-6

Six implants spread the biting load further and add stability, which can help when bone density is lower or extra support is needed.

How it is planned

A CBCT 3D scan, digital planning and a 3D-printed surgical guide place each implant in the planned position. The clinic has OPG and CBCT on site.

Who it suits

  • Most or all teeth missing in a jaw
  • Loose or uncomfortable dentures
  • Teeth that cannot be saved across a whole arch

Fee

All-on-4: ₹90,000–1,00,000 per arch. All-on-6: [gd_confirm]Fee needed[/gd_confirm]

Fees from the clinic's 2026 fee list; older pages on the site show different figures. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm fees[/gd_confirm] Your exact fee is given in writing after the exam.

For one or a few missing teeth, see dental implants.

Questions

Are All-on-4 teeth fixed or removable?

Fixed. They are screwed onto the implants and removed only by the dentist for maintenance.

Do I need bone grafting?

Often not with All-on-4, because the implants are angled to use available bone. The CBCT scan decides.

When you may need a crown

  • After a root canal on a back tooth
  • A broken, cracked or heavily filled tooth
  • Severe wear or sensitivity
  • Short, discoloured or misshapen teeth
  • On top of a dental implant

Bridges

A bridge is at least three crowns joined together to replace one or more missing teeth, anchored on the teeth either side. With good hygiene, bridges can last 10–15 years.

Which crown is best after a root canal?

Metal-free crowns (zirconia or ceramic) are the strongest-looking option; metal-ceramic crowns are a lower-cost choice for back teeth. See samples at the clinic before choosing.

How long does a crown last?

Many years with brushing, flossing and regular check-ups.

title: Wisdom Tooth Extraction in Malviya Nagar
body:
[gd_img name="opg" alt="OPG full-mouth X-ray machine at Goel Dental" cap="On-site OPG for wisdom tooth assessment"]

Does it need to come out?

The clinic's rule: if a wisdom tooth is not causing pain and shows no problem on the X-ray, it can stay. Removal is advised for:

  • Repeated pain or swelling around the tooth
  • Deep decay that is hard to clean
  • Damage to the tooth in front of it
  • A cyst forming around it

How it is done

  1. X-ray and OPG on site to see the tooth's position; CBCT for complex cases.
  2. Local anaesthetic; minimally invasive technique by the oral surgeon.
  3. PRP may be applied to help healing.
  4. Aftercare instructions and a review.

Recovery

Facial swelling can occur, more often after lower wisdom teeth. Cold compresses straight after help. Two wisdom teeth on the same side can usually be removed in one sitting.

Fee

Wisdom tooth extraction from ₹2,500. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm fee range[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Does removing a wisdom tooth affect eyesight?

No. This is a myth; wisdom teeth are not connected to the eyes.

How many wisdom teeth can be removed at once?

Usually the two on the same side (upper and lower) in one sitting.

Will my face swell?

It can, especially after lower extractions. Cold compresses immediately afterwards reduce it.

title: Tooth Extraction in Malviya Nagar

When a tooth is extracted

  • Advanced gum disease with a very loose tooth
  • Milk teeth that have not fallen out on time

Aftercare

  • Bite on gauze for 30 minutes
  • No rinsing, spitting or hot drinks for 24 hours
  • Soft, cool food the first day
  • Call if bleeding does not settle

Replacing the tooth

Options are an implant, a bridge or a denture.

title: Teeth Cleaning (Scaling and Polishing) in Malviya Nagar
body:
[gd_img name="cleaning" alt="Teeth cleaning at Goel Dental" cap="Scaling and polishing"]

Why cleaning matters

Tartar holds bacteria against the gums. Left alone it leads to bleeding gums, bad breath and, over time, gum disease and loose teeth.

Two ways to clean

MethodBest for
Ultrasonic scaling and polishingRoutine tartar and stains
EMS GBT airflowSensitive teeth, braces, crowns, veneers and implants

How often

Every six months suits most people; more often with gum disease, braces or implants.

Fee

Scaling and polishing: ₹2,500 on the 2026 fee list. The Kalkaji page lists cleaning from ₹1,500. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Does scaling damage enamel?

No. Scaling removes tartar deposits, not enamel. Teeth can feel sensitive for a few days afterwards.

Will cleaning whiten my teeth?

It removes surface stains, so teeth often look brighter. For a lighter shade than natural, whitening is a separate treatment.

title: EMS GBT (Guided Biofilm Therapy) Teeth Cleaning
body:
How it works

  1. Biofilm detection: a disclosing stain shows where plaque is.
  2. Airflow with warm water and 14 µm erythritol granules removes plaque and stains.
  3. Soft tissue cleaning of gums, cheeks and tongue.
  4. Tartar remaining is removed with a fine scaler tip.

Who benefits

  • People with very sensitive teeth
  • Braces wearers
  • Crowns, veneers and implants
  • Children, who often find it easier than scaling

title: Gum Disease Treatment and Bleeding Gums
body:
Signs of gum disease

  • Bleeding when brushing or flossing
  • Red, swollen or tender gums
  • Bad breath that does not go away
  • Gums pulling back from the teeth
  • Loose or shifting teeth

How it is treated

  1. Gum assessment with pocket measurements and X-rays.
  2. Professional cleaning: scaling or EMS GBT.
  3. Deep cleaning below the gumline where pockets are deep.
  4. Laser gum treatment with a BIOLASE soft-tissue laser where needed.
  5. Maintenance visits every 3–6 months.

Your periodontist

Dr Ambica Sharma, MDS (Periodontics), Govt Dental College Ahmedabad; three years as Senior Resident at AIIMS. [gd_confirm]Confirm she is on the current team[/gd_confirm]

Fees

[gd_confirm]Fees needed for deep cleaning and laser gum treatment[/gd_confirm]

Questions

Is bleeding from the gums serious?

It is common and usually early gum disease, which is reversible with cleaning and better home care. Do not ignore it; get a gum check.

These fees are being confirmed by the clinic. The current fee page is dated April 2022–March 2023 and differs in places. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm the full list[/gd_confirm]

Consultation and X-rays

ItemFee
General consultation₹500
Implant / cosmetic consultation₹0
X-ray, 1–3 teeth₹150
Full-mouth X-ray (OPG)₹500
CBCT scan₹2,500–4,500

Cleaning and fillings

ItemFee
Scaling and polishing₹2,500
Tooth-coloured fillingFrom ₹800
Microscope-assisted filling₹2,000

Root canals

ItemFee
Root canal: front / premolar / molar₹4,500 / 5,500 / 6,500
Single-sitting root canal₹7,500
Microscopic root canal₹8,500

Crowns

ItemFee
Metal-ceramic crown₹6,500
Zirconia crown₹8,000
Same-day CAD/CAM crown₹12,000–14,000

Implants

ItemFee
Adin / Alpha Bio₹17,000
Osstem₹35,000
Nobel Biocare₹40,000–45,000
Straumann₹55,000
All-on-4, per arch₹90,000–1,00,000
Crown on implant₹8,500–17,000

Extractions

ItemFee
Simple extraction₹500–2,500
Wisdom tooth extractionFrom ₹2,500

Payment

EMI on leading credit cards. Ask the front desk which cards and tenures apply.

Questions

Why can the final fee differ from this list?

The exam may show you need extra work, such as a crown after a root canal, or a different material. The dentist gives the fee in writing before starting.

Is the consultation fee adjusted against treatment?

Ask the front desk. [gd_confirm]Clinic policy needed[/gd_confirm]

desc: Published fees for consultation, X-rays, cleaning, fillings, root canals, crowns, implants and extractions at Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar. EMI available.

title: Our Dentists
body:
[gd_confirm]Confirm current team, photos and registration numbers[/gd_confirm]

Dr Shikha Goel

Director · Endodontist and cosmetic dentist. MDS, Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics, Bapuji Dental College (2010). Former Research Officer, AIIMS. Leads root canal, implant and cosmetic treatment. Full profile

Dr Sanchaita Kohli

Oral and maxillofacial surgeon. MDS; 13+ years at Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences. Handles wisdom teeth and complex extractions. Full profile

Dr Nisheet Sharma

Orthodontist. MDS Orthodontics, IDST Muradnagar. Complex alignment, relapse cases, invisible and lingual braces. Full profile

Dr Parag Gupta

Orthodontist. Trained at I.T.S-CDSR Muradnagar; member, Indian Orthodontic Society. Full profile

Dr Ambica Sharma

Periodontist (gum specialist). MDS, Govt Dental College Ahmedabad; three years Senior Resident, AIIMS. Gum treatment. Full profile

Dr Akansha Uniyal

In-house dentist. BDS and MDS (Oral Pathology), Maulana Azad Dental College, New Delhi. Full profile

Kalkaji branch

The Kalkaji clinic at Irene Hospital is headed by Dr Dipanshu under Dr Shikha Goel's supervision. [gd_confirm]Clinic to confirm[/gd_confirm]

title: Dentist near Saket: Goel Dental, Malviya Nagar
body:

  • Metro: Saket to Malviya Nagar (Yellow Line), one stop. Exit at Gate 1 and walk about 10 minutes along Main Shivalik Road; the clinic is next to Sunil Hospital.
  • Road: Main Shivalik Road runs between Malviya Nagar and Saket. [gd_confirm]Parking details[/gd_confirm]

Address

Goel Dental, 14/185 Main Shivalik Road, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi 110017. [gd_confirm]Ground vs Lower Ground floor[/gd_confirm]
